# Awan

> Awan is an AI buddy that lives on your Mac, made by FF Dev Studio (FF DEV STUDIO, 202603234793, Malaysia). Hold Control + Option and ask out loud: Awan looks at your screen, answers, and points at the answer. It also types your dictation into any text box and runs agents ("Awans") that do multi-step work in your apps. It is in private beta for macOS 14 Sonoma or later.

Key facts:

- Talk: hold Control + Option to ask by voice; double-tap Control to type instead. Awan takes a screenshot only while the hotkey is held; screenshots are not stored.
- Dictation: hold Control + fn to dictate into any text field.
- Agents: say "awan, agent" to hand off a job. Each agent (an "Awan") has a name and character, can use skills, computer use and connectors you add (MCP servers or API keys), and can run routines on a schedule.
- Plans (USD): Free $0 (25 talks, plenty of dictation, 25 agent messages per 30 days); Pro $20/month or $16/month billed yearly (unlimited talk and dictation, 150 agent messages); Max $100/month or $80/month billed yearly (1,000 agent messages). Students get 50% off the first month of Pro.
- Referrals: every account has awan.ffdev.studio/@handle. Friends get 25% off their first month; referrers earn 25% of each eligible payment for 12 months.
- Privacy: no background recording, no keystroke or clipboard logging, no third-party analytics in the beta. AI processing via OpenAI, Anthropic and OpenRouter; voices via ElevenLabs; payments via Stripe.
